allResults.question: HOTSPOT - You are building a text-to-speech app that will use a custom neural voice. You need to create an SSML file for the app. The solution must ensure that the voice profile meets the following requirements: • Expresses a calm tone • Imitates the voice of a young adult female How should you complete the code? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point. Code: <mstts:express-as [Box 1]="YoungAdultFemale" [Box 2]="gentle"> How can I assist you? </mstts:express-as> Dropdown options for each box: role, style, styledegree, type, voice
allResults.explanation: Box 1 = role, Box 2 = style. The 'role' attribute imitates a different age/gender (YoungAdultFemale). The 'style' attribute controls emotional tone (gentle = calm). See: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cognitive-services/speech-service/speech-synthesis-markup-voice#speaking-styles-and-roles
